meta_reflection.observation: Filings-first order is adequate only if period tags and intra-year coverage are true. For JD.L they are not: period_coverage annual=15/interim=0/trading_update=0 counts eight CH accounts (2019–2026), a May 2025 FY25 results RNS (duplicated), and six Google News ‘Across The Markets’ wraps (JD Wetherspoon / Helios Towers / BHP) as annual, while the live August 2026 profit-warning trading update is absent. yahoo_quarterly_cashflow sits on the ladder but is empty (TTM suppressed); alternate_news and ir_presentation_metrics are dead steps. Headline-only news therefore carries the only post-FY26 operating print, ranked below empty quarterlies.

Four worker types plus a five-task cap force two annual bodies (CH FY26 + FY25 RNS) + news + screen + gap and leave no slot for TVR, the Global Impact Report, or a later-ingested August TU. There is no tagged interim, so a second summarize_filing_body cannot be an H1 without inventing a source. No task type exists to reconcile filing £462m / Yahoo £956m / screen £830m FCF, to cluster JD.com / JD Wetherspoon / JD Vance collisions, or to parse an IR deck. gap_inventory can only list the missing Aug-20 RNS — it cannot fill it.

The screen still emits buy (11/22, 5/5 families including dividend at 1.4% yield and FCF Yield at 21.4%) while failed_models is [] despite 11 non-passes, TTM cashflow is suppressed, and fcf_definition_divergence / cyclical_exposure_detected / interim_quality_overlay / cash_conversion_overlay stay false on a three-way FCF split and a sports-fashion cyclical. A 12-week persistent buy since 2026-08-02 with an in-flight FY27 £200m buyback, a 20 Aug 2026 guidance cut that has no filing body, a 1 Sep chair start (Agnefjäll), and a £1.5bn Genesis NCI option in 2029–30 has no watch schema (ingest of the Aug TU / next H1, remaining buyback vs TVR, FY27 guidance checkpoints, Nike/footwear read-across, Genesis). conviction_score 1.0 and stability_label=persistent are not substitutes for those monitors.

A generic FINANCIAL REVIEW / RISKS split will blend UK, Europe and NA and will not force GEO MIX, FCF-DEFINITION (company £462m vs Yahoo £956m vs screen £830m, including the FY26 KPI change), LEASE vs EX-LEASE NET CASH, GENESIS NCI, CAPITAL RETURNS (1.4% dividend vs cash buybacks), or an explicit PRIMARY-FILING GAP box for the missing August trading update.
